summary: Recursively scan nested Robot and Python files
description: scan_fixtures walks subdirectories under root so a real Robot repository produces nodes, not only files sitting directly in tests/fixtures.
scope: Change scan_fixtures in src/living_graph/scan.py to walk nested folders
Parse .robot, .resource, and .py files found in subdirectories
A tiny nested fixture file must appear in the returned graph
acceptanceCriteria: scan_fixtures on a temp root that contains nested/dir/deep.robot includes a node sourced from that nested path.
constraints: Strict TDD: write the failing test first and run it before implementation.
Do not add work beyond this task.
Do not add UI, watcher, or CLI code unless this task explicitly requires it.
Do not start a watch loop.

subtasks.title: Walk subdirectories when scanning
subtasks.summary: rglob or walk. Tiny nested .robot fixture. No 3D.

relatedArtifacts.purpose: GRAPH-015 currently uses Path.iterdir() on the top folder only.

Change only scan_fixtures to walk nested folders.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_scan_recursive.py -q and stop when it passes.
